coursedescription: Beginning Thai I is designed for the beginning students with no previous knowledge of Thai and to introduce course participants to Thai language and culture. In addition to Thai scripts and phonology, this course will introduce vocabulary, simple sentence structures, everyday conversations and various aspects of Thai culture. Fall 1 Course Unit

Beginning Thai II is designed for the beginning student with no previous knowledge of Thai and to introduce course participants toThai language and culture. In addition to Thai scripts and phonology, this course will continue the introduction to the vocabulary, simple sentence structures, everyday conversations and various aspects of Thai culture. Spring Prerequisite: THAI 0100 1 Course Unit

Intermediate Thai I is designed for students with prior knowledge of Thai. This course builds on foundational skills by introducing more complex vocabulary, sentence structures, and extended conversations. Students will continue to develop their listening, speaking, reading, and writing skills, with an emphasis on spoken Thai and fluency. Various aspects of Thai culture will be integrated into the lessons. The medium of instruction is both Thai and English. Two Term Class, Student must enter first term; credit given after both terms are complete Prerequisite: THAI 0200 1 Course Unit

A continuation of Intermediate Thai I, this class builds on the speaking and writing skills learned in that class. This intermediate level course is designed for students who have completed Intermediate Thai I or possess equivalent proficiency. This course focuses on expanding students’ vocabulary, complex sentence structures, and long-form conversations. Greater emphasis will be placed on reading and writing skills while reinforcing listening and speaking abilities. Thai cultural elements will be incorporated throughout the course. The medium of instruction is both Thai and English. 1 Course Unit
